name: Femeref
description: City on Jamuraa governed by Teshunda.

timeline.summary: Sidar Jabari warns Kaervek that Suq'Ata, Femeref and Zhalfirins are now joined.
timeline.quote: "Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."

citation.text: Divine Offering (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Council of Voices is slain in one instant, leaving Asmira sole leader of Femeref.
timeline.quote: But in one terrible instant, they were slain, leaving Asmira as the sole voice of leadership."

citation.text: Dark Banishing (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek says night stalkers of Urborg are willing tools in plundering Femeref.
timeline.quote: Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref."

citation.text: Feral Shadow (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara creates a peace agreement between Jamuraa's rival nations and a buffer zone policed by Quirion elves.
timeline.quote: Within a century Mangara's Harmony created a new age of enlightenment.

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Conflict and Mangara's Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Mangara vanishes, Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata unite against Kaervek, who is first aided by the deceived Jolrael.
timeline.quote: Zhalfir, Femeref, and Suq-Ata united against the evil wizard Kaervek after the vanishing of Mangara.

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "The Mirage Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara arrives in Jamuraa after meeting Jolrael and Kaervek and brokers peace among the nations, settling the Zhalfir-Femeref border with a buffer zone of Quirion Elves.
timeline.quote: Mangara brokered peace between the rival nations

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara's diplomacy produces peace agreements between the rival nations.
timeline.quote: Mangara's gifts for diplomacy and intimidation encouraged peace agreements within a few short years.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Coming of Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Suq'Ata annexes the northern Ekundu Mountains from Femeref.
timeline.quote: They annexed the northern Ekundu Mountains from Femeref

citation.text: "Suq'Ata", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Spirit of the Night slaughters the entire Femeref grand assembly.
timeline.quote: The entire Femeref grand assembly was slaughtered by a terrifying entity known as the Spirit of the Night .

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mangara rebuilds Zhalfir and Femeref after Kaervek's fall.
timeline.quote: Mangara rebuilt Zhalfir and Femeref, aided by the new trust between the two countries.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns thirty years later to a continent near war, tutors Yormeba and crowns her queen, then leaves with advisors for the Chaza Isles.
timeline.quote: After crowning her as Queen Yormeba , she brought peace to the nation but failed to unify it.

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "The Femeref secession". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Efravan refugees migrate to Femeref where they are welcomed.
timeline.quote: they were welcomed to stay

citation.text: "Efrava", section "Efrava in modern days". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niambi is dropped home and blesses her father's return to adventuring.
timeline.quote: This is what you were born to do.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Years later Subira settles down with Teferi and they raise Niambi.
timeline.quote: A few years ago, Subira had found someone else to run her caravan, and she had settled down with Teferi

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Niambi mid-fall by instinct.
timeline.quote: Teferi cast the spell out of pure instinct and Niambi froze in mid-air.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi releases the spell and catches Niambi.
timeline.quote: As time moved around her again, she landed in her father's arms and laughed with delight.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Niambi examines Pallar, who asks why she risks the magistrate's displeasure by helping the Efravan, and Niambi tells her a dream of birds and a diseased tree.
timeline.quote: I saw a flock of birds searching for a home over a vast ocean.

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Zar reports a tunnel to the abandoned mine is complete, and the Efravan plan to flee that night; Niambi insists on one more attempt with the magistrate.
timeline.quote: "When night falls and the first stars shine, we will move."

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Niambi uses her glowing hands and a dream story to persuade guards to let her into the magistrate's estate.
timeline.quote: Touched by her words and the sun magic running through them, the guards allowed her through.

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Niambi drives away with the magistrate in a carriage as Awateh, Gbega and Jabras try to stop them.
timeline.quote: "You'll kill us all!" screamed Awateh

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Asmira sees an early harvest as an omen of war and warns Femeref's theocracy, but few believe her.
timeline.quote: Asmira saw this as an omen of war and warned the theocracy of Femeref, but there were but few who believed her.

citation.text: "Asmira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Asmira is appointed Sidar of the Femeref armies and leads them against Kaervek's forces.
timeline.quote: Asmira was appointed Sidar, Zhalfirin for general, of the Femeref armies.

citation.text: "Asmira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Great Chamber Awateh argues against Niambi's challenge to the decree denying aid to the Efravan caravan, fearing Phyrexian infiltrators.
timeline.quote: Awateh argued against Niambi , a speaker and advisor

citation.text: "Awateh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Awateh's rhetoric contributes to the Council's unanimous decision to reject aid to the Efravan.
timeline.quote: Awateh's rhetoric contributed significantly to the Council's unanimous decision to reject aid

citation.text: "Awateh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Days later, Awateh and two councilors see Niambi bringing the Sidar to the Efravan mines and rush after him, arriving too late.
timeline.quote: They shouted for Teshunda to stop, but their voices were unheeded.

citation.text: "Awateh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A religious dispute over the Shadow Creed's treatment of the dead leads the church to secede from Zhalfir and found Femeref.
timeline.quote: an internal religious dispute led the church to secede

citation.text: "Femeref", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Suq'Ata Empire annexes lands and mines the mountains, pushing dwarves into Femeref, which welcomes them.
timeline.quote: The empire annexed the lands bordering Zhalfir and began to mine the mountains

citation.text: "Femeref", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Threatened by a Phyrexian Colossus, Femeref falls into infighting until Niambi convinces Teshunda to shelter the Efravans.
timeline.quote: It was only Esteemed Speaker Niambi who was able to convince Teshunda to grant the Efravans refuge.

citation.text: "Femeref", section "Modern Day". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Great Chamber, Niambi petitions the Council to lift the decree against aiding the Efravan; Jabras and others refuse.
timeline.quote: maintained a firm stance against assisting

citation.text: "Jabras", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jabras, Awateh and Gbega see Niambi take Teshunda to the Efravan mines, and follow too late; Teshunda welcomes the Efravan to Femeref.
timeline.quote: Teshunda had made up his mind and had welcomed the Efravan to Femeref

citation.text: "Jabras", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pallar gave birth to her daughter Lark.
timeline.quote: The story culminated with the successful birth of her daughter, Lark

citation.text: "Pallar Ojanen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sidar Teshunda reluctantly accepted the Efravan into the city thanks to Niambi's advocacy.
timeline.quote: the reluctant but eventual acceptance of the Efravan into the city by Sidar Teshunda

citation.text: "Pallar Ojanen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niambi challenges the decree against aiding the Efravan caravan before the Council.
timeline.quote: Niambi , a speaker and advisor, who challenged a decree preventing aid to the Efravan caravan

citation.text: "Teshunda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niambi persuades Teshunda to visit the Efravan in their mine.
timeline.quote: persuaded Teshunda to visit the Efravan people

citation.text: "Teshunda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teshunda is moved by the Efravan, including Pallar Ojanen and her infant Lark.
timeline.quote: These simple, domestic moments touched Teshunda deeply

citation.text: "Teshunda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teshunda rules to welcome the Efravan to Femeref despite his council.
timeline.quote: he welcomed the Efravan to Femeref in a final ruling

citation.text: "Teshunda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niambi and Denik aid the refugees despite prejudice from locals and Teshunda's council.
timeline.quote: Together, they faced prejudice and hostility from the local population and city officials

citation.text: "Zar Ojanen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niambi appeals to Teshunda using a dream of birds tending a sick tree.
timeline.quote: Niambi appealed to Magistrate Teshunda to reconsider his opposition to the refugees.

citation.text: "Zar Ojanen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pallar gives birth to Lark in the abandoned mine; Teshunda is moved to grant asylum in Femeref.
timeline.quote: Teshunda was moved to grant asylum to the Efravan in the city of Femeref .

citation.text: "Zar Ojanen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
